messages:
anya: heads up — platform needs a quick sync on KV + prefix cache observability. product wants hit rate + evictions + reuse-by-workload exposed for the new rollout. who can help wire runtime -> metrics pipeline?
sam: I can take the runtime bits. thinking we emit counters: cache_prefix_hits_total, cache_prefix_misses_total, cache_evictions_total with labels {model_family, route, workload, seq_len_bucket, cache_variant}
javier: careful on labels — route and model can explode cardinality. prefer route=? and model_family only. also add tenant_hash instead of raw tenant id.
maria: for the Console we need per-route panels and a single cross-route overview. UX ask: show hit rate trend, eviction spikes, and reuse distribution.
anya: agree on tenant_hash. what's seq_len_bucket? we want to see short vs long sequence reuse patterns.
sam: seq_len_bucket will be coarse: short(<=64), mid(65-512), long(>512). we can emit it as a label — low-cardinality.
javier: pipeline note — our metrics ingestion drops high-cardinality metrics if unique label combos > 10k/min. recommend we also emit a sampling counter: cache_sample_hits_total and cache_sample_reuse_counts histogram for debugging.
maria: can you paste example PromQL and suggested panel configs? I can mock the dashboard.
sam: sure, basic PromQL for hit rate (grafana calc):
```
sum(rate(cache_prefix_hits_total{cache_variant!="debug"}[5m]))
/
sum(rate(cache_prefix_hits_total{cache_variant!="debug"}[5m]) + rate(cache_prefix_misses_total{cache_variant!="debug"}[5m]))
```
panel: stacked line for hit rate by model_family, option to group by route for the detail view.

For evictions:
```
sum(rate(cache_evictions_total[5m])) by (reason)
```
show as bar/heatmap.

For reuse distribution (histogram):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(cache_reuse_bucket[5m])) by (le, workload))
```

javier: nit — prefer storing hits/misses as counters and computing ratio in Grafana to avoid reset issues. also add cache_evictions_total{reason="capacity|ttl|manual"}.
anya: what about per-canary variant dashboards? during rollout product wants to compare cache_variant=canary vs stable.
sam: we'll include label cache_variant={stable,canary,baseline}. add a derived panel that shows delta of hit rate between canary and stable.
maria: UX: add toggle to filter for cache_variant and tenant_hash. also a small sparklines table per route with hit rate, eviction rate, median reuse.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: new metrics-schema PR opened by @sam: https://git.internal/r/12345 — CI lint ok.
sam: PR link — contains runtime emission changes plus a config flag `cache.metrics.enable_detailed` default false.
javier: we need to avoid a storm of label combinations when enable_detailed=true. add an opt-in sampling: detailed emitted for 0.1% of requests by default.
anya: product decision: start with default=false. for initial canary enable detailed=true for 1% of traffic for 1h windows. we only need aggregated counters for the GA.
maria: dashboard panels should surface sampling rate so numbers are normalized. include a calculated panel: normalized_hit_rate = hits/samples / (hits+misses)/samples.
sam: implementation detail: runtime will emit both raw counters and a separate sampled_reuse histogram with label sample=true. that lets graphs show detailed reuse without raising cardinality for all.
javier: telemetry pipeline change request: add rule to rewrite tenant_hash to short prefix + add ingestion tag 'cache_v1'. I'll open an infra PR.
anya: cool. alerts: product ops wants alert if global hit_rate < 25% for 10m or eviction_rate > 100 evictions/min for 5m. thoughts?
ops-bot: incident-bot: page on-call if alert fires.
javier: thresholds look fine as staging. for prod maybe 20% hit_rate. also create a warning alert (pagerduty severity=low) at 30% so we get early signals.
maria: we'll add dashboard annotation for rollout windows and an A/B comparator panel. I need the exact metric names and label sets to finalize.
sam: metric list: cache_prefix_hits_total{model_family,route,workload,seq_len_bucket,cache_variant,tenant_hash}, cache_prefix_misses_total{same}, cache_evictions_total{reason,model_family,cache_variant}, cache_reuse_bucket (le, workload, cache_variant) histogram, cache_sampled_traces_total{sample_rate}.
anya: owners: runtime (sam) implement metrics + sampling code, infra (javier) update ingestion + retention, console (maria) mock panels and alert config, product (anya) run canary plan. timeline: PRs this week, canary next Tue.
sam: I'll update the PR with the exact labels and add tests for counter emission.
javier: opening infra PR for rewrite+ingest rules, ETA EOD.
maria: I'll drop dashboard mock by EOD and share permission for review.
anya: thanks — really appreciate the quick turnaround. @everyone please react with :thumbsup: if this plan looks good or flag concerns now.
dev-platform-bot: reaction summary — 4 :thumbsup:, 1 :eyes:"
